title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression checks and CI gating
author: Priya Natarajan
description: Add per-prompt regression checks to the eval-harness and wire them into CI as a quality gating step. This change introduces a new manifest format for prompt-sets with thresholds, a lightweight runner that computes per-prompt metrics (BLEU/ROUGE/embedding-sim) against golden outputs, and a blocking GitHub Action that fails the PR when any prompt exceeds regression thresholds. Includes migration of existing prompt sets and docs. Checklist: - add per-prompt runner - implement thresholds in eval config - CI action to run on push and PR - docs and migration script - add tests for edge cases Related: ENG-1423, ENG-1589
commits: Add CI action and workflow bindings (2/5)
Fix flaky metric computation and add unit tests (3/5)
Address review feedback and add canary gating (5/5)
review_comments: Alex Chen: Please quantify expected runtime for large prompt-sets; CI timeout must be reasonable.
Author: Added estimated runtimes and implemented sampling mode when >1000 prompts.
Marta Lopez: lgtm but prefer using embeddings-based metric for open-ended prompts — added embedding similarity with cosine threshold.
Jamal Wright: CI action should be optional for release branches; added branch filter and opt-in flag.
ci_checks: integration-tests: pass (flaky on first run, reran)
release_notes: Adds per-prompt regression checks and CI gating to eval-harness. Introduces new prompt manifest schema and CI workflow. Migration script provided.
